description: He wears a dark slate-blue knee-length wool tunic with gold-beige knotwork trim around the neckline, down the open front, at the cuffs and along the hem. A cream linen underlayer shows at the raised collar, sleeve ends and lower front opening. Two round metal brooches joined by a short chain decorate the upper chest. A wide brown leather belt with embossed ornamentation and a round metal buckle has a long decorated hanging tail. Brown trousers are tucked into tall brown leather boots bound with crossing straps.
